title: The Second Row
text: The same hulls again, in Kindred's colours: sand-yellow, black chevrons on the bay doors, flaking. Under the paint, the same petals and the same welds. The stencils read KINDRED 11, KINDRED 10, and on down the row.

lines.text: "Kindred's archive says their ship was the only one of its kind. It has ten older sisters here, and it doesn't know."

choices.label: Scan the bay
choices.reply: Cryo racks, human-rated, the same racks as ours. Every one of them empty, and opened from the outside.

choices.label: Keep going
choices.reply: The next hull is KINDRED 9. You stop reading the numbers aloud.
